meta.note: An excerpt of each contribution a sitting member made to a Commons or Westminster Hall debate about Gaza, Israel or Palestine since 7 October 2023, taken verbatim from Hansard under the Open Parliament Licence. The excerpt is the part of the member’s longest contribution to that debate that first names the subject; the link is to the whole debate.
